## What does a language model do?

A language model predicts what comes next.

. . .

It does this one token at a time.

. . .

Surprisingly rich behavior can emerge from that simple objective.

::: {.notes}
Use this slide to establish the central intuition. Pause after each sentence and ask students what they think “predicts what comes next” leaves out.
:::

## Progressive reveal

::: {.incremental}
- The model receives a sequence of tokens.
- It estimates probabilities for the next token.
- One token is selected.
- The process repeats.
:::

::: {.notes}
The bullets appear one at a time. Advance with the right arrow or space bar.
:::

## Two-column layout

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="45%"}
### Capability

AI systems can:

- summarize text
- generate code
- classify images
- answer questions
:::

::: {.column width="55%"}
### Limitation

Performance depends on:

- the task
- the prompt
- the available context
- the consequences of error
:::

::::

::: {.notes}
This replaces the Beamer multicols environment. The widths can be changed directly in the Markdown.
:::

## A chart generated in R

```{r}
years <- 2018:2026
index <- c(1, 1.4, 2.1, 3.2, 5.0, 8.2, 13.5, 21.0, 34.0)

plot(
  years,
  index,
  type = "b",
  pch = 19,
  xlab = "Year",
  ylab = "Illustrative capability index",
  main = "Illustrative AI progress"
)
```

::: {.notes}
This is deliberately fictional data. The purpose is only to confirm that ordinary R code chunks work in Quarto.
:::

## Discussion

> When does an impressive technical capability become an economically important technology?

. . .

Think about the organizational changes required before capability becomes value.

::: {.notes}
Give students one minute to discuss this with a neighbor before taking responses.
:::

## Presenter controls

During the presentation:

- Press **F** for full screen.
- Press **S** for speaker view.
- Use the arrow keys or space bar to advance.
- Press **O** for the slide overview.

::: {.notes}
The speaker window displays these notes, the next slide, and a timer.
:::
